must_identify.text: The two detections on talonmacbook (periodic HTTPS and the newly observed high-entropy DNS domain) are correlated into one candidate C2 thread rather than treated as two separate low-value alerts.

The recon delta's new talonmacbook:8443/tcp listener with a self-signed certificate is tied into the beaconing hypothesis as a plausible staging or reverse channel, with the benign reading (a local service) stated as an alternative.
The beacon is presented as a hypothesis needing confirmation, not a confirmed compromise: periodicity is inferred from rule assertions and cannot be established from the intake alone.

Options include pulling PCAP or flow records for the interval to measure beacon period and jitter, resolving and reputation-checking the domain and destination, and identifying the process bound to 8443/tcp.
The brief names exactly what evidence would move confidence from Medium to High (a measured low-jitter interval and a cited malicious reputation or an owning process).
